recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is. Future clarification or behavior changes for optionExclusive should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack or SDC guidance rather than by reintroducing the moved core extension source.
issue_request: FHIR-12173 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Questionnaire request to add a standard extension on Questionnaire.item.option for an exclusive multiple-choice option such as "None of the above".
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in core source by SVN #10502, represented in git as b3c368f1b129d19e555b47d97a26aba901e71255, which added optionExclusive to source/questionnaire/questionnaire-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with the "Option is exclusive" definition. Later Questionnaire option naming changed to answerOption, and the current extension definition uses that context.
additional_context: Current core source still has Questionnaire in the active resource list and preserves the OID assignment, but it no longer carries individual Questionnaire extension StructureDefinitions. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the extension definitions from R5 core source, including questionnaire-optionExclusive. The current maintained definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Questionnaire/StructureDefinition-questionnaire-optionExclusive.xml, with the canonical URL, boolean value, and Questionnaire.item.answerOption context. FHIR-19377 later decided questionnaire-optionExclusive should not be a modifier, which matches the current Extension Pack source. FHIR-18259 is SDC guidance/example background rather than a core-source change.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Reintroducing a core StructureDefinition would duplicate an artifact that has moved to the Extension Pack, and the Extension Pack source already satisfies FHIR-12173 for the current build family.

related_jiras.note: Later core issue reviewed questionnaire-optionExclusive modifier status and decided it should not be a modifier; this supports the current Extension Pack shape.
